name: The Sportsmans Pub & Grill
address: Rietvlei Rd, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Laid-back pub and grill in Plettenberg Bay serving hearty grills, cold beers, and proper pub fare.
description_long:
The Sportsmans Pub & Grill is your go-to spot in Plettenberg Bay for unpretentious grub and a good time. This neighbourhood pub delivers exactly what you'd expect — flame-grilled steaks, juicy burgers, and classic pub meals that hit the spot after a day exploring the Garden Route. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, with sports on the screens and cold beers on tap.

Located on Rietvlei Road, it's a favourite among locals and visitors looking for honest food without the fuss. Whether you're catching the game with mates or grabbing a casual dinner with the family, The Sportsmans keeps things simple and satisfying. Good value, good vibes, and portions that won't leave you hungry.
